# openmetadata_worksheet (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata worksheet by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_worksheet" "q1" {
  fully_qualified_name = "google-drive.budget.q1"
}

output "q1_worksheet_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_worksheet.q1.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Worksheet fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Worksheet UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `name` (String) Worksheet name.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the drive service.
- `spreadsheet` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent spreadsheet.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
